## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
One Important fix remains: `README.md:3` still says requests time out after 30 seconds, but the default is now 60. This review read the one-line change in `app/cli.py`, the parser tests and the README, and searched the repository for other references to the old timeout. The code change is correct: `parse_args` reads `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT` (`app/cli.py:8`), and `test_defaults` checks the new value of 60. `test_explicit_options` checks that an explicit `--timeout` overrides the default.

## Changes
The PR raises `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT` in `app/cli.py` from 30 to 60 seconds and updates `test_defaults` to expect 60. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` file at the repository root.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:3 — comments — Update the README default timeout to 60 seconds — Once `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 60` is merged, the README is wrong: at `README.md:3` it still says "Requests time out after 30 seconds unless you pass `--timeout SECONDS`." A search of the repository found no other mention of the timeout default, so the README is the only user documentation of this value, and it is now stale. — Users who rely on the README will expect requests to fail after 30 seconds when they actually wait up to 60, so they may set wrong expectations or add a needless `--timeout 30` thinking it changes nothing. — Fix: Change `README.md:3` to say 60 seconds.
